rechercher_collectes.name: Search collections
rechercher_collectes.description: Searches EFS collections around a postal code (or coordinates), within a radius, for a donation type over the next N days, and returns them as a response. Used by the efs-collectes-card Lovelace card; creates no entity.

commune.name: Municipality
commune.description: Name or INSEE code, when the postal code covers several municipalities (default: first in alphabetical order).

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Starting point without postal code (with longitude).

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Starting point without postal code (with latitude).

rayon_km.name: Radius
rayon_km.description: Search radius around the starting point. 0 = collections in the starting municipality only (postal code required).

type_don.name: Donation type
type_don.description: Collection type: whole blood, plasma or platelets.

jours.name: Number of days
jours.description: Collections from today up to this many days ahead.

inclure_professionnelles.name: Include workplace/school collections
inclure_professionnelles.description: Often restricted to staff or students.
